sources.excerpt: Silver Pony is documented as being based on the silver-era Klon Centaur. Unlike BYOC's usual preference for true bypass on cloned circuits, the Silver Pony retains the original-style pop-free buffered bypass system. The reviewed source identifies the silver-era Centaur basis. No numbered BYOC revision is established in the reviewed source. The archive records the Klon Centaur circuit family as the design reference without adding unsupported component or voicing claims. 1. sources.h1: Build Your Own Clone Silver Pony
sources.excerpt: Silver Pony Published on July 31, 2014 Build Your Own Clone overdrive pedal Classics Information The BYOC Silver Pony is based on the silver-era Klon Centaur. The Silver Pony incorporates the exact same pop-free, buffered bypass system as the original. Normally, we remove buffered bypass from the circuits we clone in favor of true bypass, but the buffer in this circuit is actually very nice, so we kept it. - **Builder:** Build Your Own Clone - **Catalog type:** Overdrive - **Identity:** Silver-era Klon Centaur-based overdrive kit.
